## The right skill at the right time changes everything.

65% of rural youth remain unemployed despite having degrees - not because they lack ambition, but because they lack practical, employer-ready skills. Our Digital Education & Employment Program directly bridges this gap.

We provide structured training in Tally Prime, digital literacy, computer basics, GST filing, soft skills, resume writing, and interview preparation - followed by active job placement support until every youth finds dignified employment.

## Key highlights

- 4.5 month structured training program
- 30 youth per batch
- 80% job placement target
- Baseline to endline impact tracking
- Employer-aligned curriculum

## Who it is for

Rural and underserved youth aged 18-30, minimum 12th pass, from low-income families who are educated but unable to find employment due to lack of practical digital skills.

## SDG alignment

SDG 4 - Quality Education  
SDG 8 - Decent Work & Economic Growth  
SDG 1 - No Poverty  
SDG 10 - Reduced Inequalities
